svg.title: How the system fits together: inputs, automation, Wrenfield’s systems, outputs
svg.text: 07 · THE SOLUTION: HOW IT FITS TOGETHER
Wrenfield’s accounts, built and run by Halyard
Unanswered after 20 s, or out of hours:
14 workflows, each logged. Pauses on error and tells
Bills into Xero, job number kept
Halyard’s own code. Money maths, no AI.
Pay by bank and card on invoices
Violet = AI. It reads and drafts; ServiceM8, Xero and people make every decision that sends, books, charges or certifies.
